information: ## West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Riverside for Western Championship 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NjQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cf643f8826077f011ac9001e0e28d1f7cb4b8b45/WesternsLogo%20-%20Edited.png) ### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66525-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2026!** The highest-placing competitor from the Western Region in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! Check out the [Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66534-western-champion-eligibility) for more information. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the New Competitor section on the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66527-faq) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2026#66533-sponsors).
